name: Bradley County, TN
findings: Bradley County has 279 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bradley County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Bradley County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 114 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Bradley County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 90 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 11 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 24 would.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 29 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
